files.document_title: Figures 1A to 1L, Topographic Map, Natural Gas Pipeline NEPA EA, Pennyrile Regional Energy Agency, Kentucky (Ensafe, June 2024)
files.what_it_shows: Twelve detailed sheets on a US Geological Survey 1:24,000 base. The proposed route is a magenta line with labeled latitude and longitude points along it. This sheet (1B) shows the route paralleling Interstate 24 across the Caldwell and Trigg county line. The twelve sheets cover the whole route from near the Tennessee line eastward.

files.document_title: Figure 1B topographic map, Pennyrile Regional Energy Agency
files.what_it_shows: Rendered page 1 at 150 dpi. Also shows an inset of the full route in the western Kentucky.
A text application with the interlocal agency agreement as Exhibit 1. It has no route map.

searched: Both attached documents on the oilandgaswatch record were downloaded and read.
The 12-sheet topographic map set is better than the Low-grade oilandgaswatch geometry and shows the route at 1:24,000 with coordinate labels.
No further search was run because the attached set already meets the map-good test.
notes: This is the best map for comparison with the oilandgaswatch geometry. The route in the figure follows the Interstate 24 corridor from the west end near the Tennessee line eastward, with labeled coordinates on every sheet. Only sheet 1B was viewed in full in this pass. The page order in the PDF runs 1B, 1C, 1D and so on to 1A last, so page 12 is sheet 1A at the west end. The coordinate labels printed on the sheets could serve as independently sourced control points. The map does not name the pipeline end points beyond the sheet labels. The 2023 application PDF has no route map. Its file has no extension at the source, so it was saved with a .pdf extension.
